from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from calendar import monthrange

def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    # Parse the input date
    year, month, date = map(int, day.split('-'))
    
    # Check if the input day is the last day of its month
    last_day_of_month = monthrange(year, month)[1]
    is_last_day = (date == last_day_of_month)
    
    # Calculate target month and year
    target_month = month + n
    target_year = year
    
    # Adjust year and month if necessary
    while target_month > 12:
        target_month -= 12
        target_year += 1
    while target_month < 1:
        target_month += 12
        target_year -= 1
    
    # Get the last day of the target month
    last_day_of_target = monthrange(target_year, target_month)[1]
    
    # Determine the day to use in the target month
    if is_last_day:
        # If original day was last day of month, use last day of target month
        target_day = last_day_of_target
    else:
        # Otherwise, use the same day if it exists, otherwise use last day
        target_day = min(date, last_day_of_target)
    
    # Format and return the result
    return f"{target_year:04d}-{target_month:02d}-{target_day:02d}"
